_notes.CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR: Root the hooks resolve paths against; empty means the process working directory.
_notes.CI: Set to 1 by the test-gate hook so the test command runs non-interactively.
_notes.PORT: Port the demo server listens on.
_notes.BM_FILE: Data file the bookmarks demo reads and writes.
_notes.HABITS_FILE: Data file the habit demos read and write.
_notes.EVAL_REPO: Path to this repo, set by evals/run-local.mjs so graders can reach its checks.
_notes.NODE_PATH: Node module resolution path; cleared by the ui-check test.
_notes.TERM: Terminal type for CLI scoring runs.
_notes.FAKE_LOG: Where the fake claude stub logs its calls (test helpers only).
_notes.usage: Copy to config.json (gitignored) or export these as environment variables. The kit itself reads no config file; these are the variables its scripts and hooks read.
